overview: The Shak Dratha Hive is the seat of fungal hive-mind power in Fungus Grove.
details: Hive-priests channel psychic spores through mycelial networks. Communion rituals bind lesser fungal creatures into the hive-mind. The Hive-Heart pulses with alien intelligence.
hooks: A hive-priest begins a dangerous communion ritual.
A psychic spore storm erupts from the Hive-Heart.
The Hive-Hierophant awakens to defend the hive.
